summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs checks whether `bun` is on PATH and, if absent, downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the host platform, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` from the package root at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-only file (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated using the obfuscator.io string-array + rotator scheme (hex-mangled identifiers, a large mixed number/string constant array, and a rotator function that shifts that array). The package advertises itself as an auto-generated TypeScript axios API client (dist/*.api.js) and has no functional need for a second language runtime or a large opaque sibling payload at install time. Executing the payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-only tooling and static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
